description: Ranks the tools in this API against a plain-language task and returns the best matches with method, URL, price and input schema. The free catalog is at /llms.txt and /openapi.json. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

task.description: What you need to do, e.g. check if a token is a rug pull

name: tool_catalog
